definitions.explanation: A facility where convicted criminals serve their sentences. The formal term used in legal and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{刑務所|けいむしょ}に{入|はい}った。
{刑務所|けいむしょ}から{出|で}たばかりの{男|おとこ}がいる。
examples.english: There's a man who just got out of prison.

examples.japanese: その{犯人|はんにん}は{刑務所|けいむしょ}で{十年間|じゅうねんかん}{過|す}ごすことになった。
examples.english: The criminal ended up spending ten years in prison.

notes:
{刑務所|けいむしょ} is the standard formal term for a prison or penitentiary where convicted criminals serve their sentences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}に{入|はい}る: to go to prison
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}から{出|で}る: to get out of prison
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}に{収容|しゅうよう}される: to be incarcerated
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}{暮|く}らし: prison life

RELATED FACILITIES:
- {拘置所|こうちしょ}: detention center (for those awaiting trial)
- {留置場|りゅうちじょう}: police holding cell (short-term)
- {少年院|しょうねんいん}: juvenile detention facility

USAGE:
In casual speech, {刑務所|けいむしょ} may be shortened to ムショ. The slang expression ムショ{帰|がえ}り means someone who has done time in prison.
